text_block_list.text:
I could hear everyone's voices while<n>I was
running.

You can do it! "Go, Rice, go!"<n>Everyone was urging
me onward.

Hehe, this isn't right. I promised I<n>would make
everyone smile...
But I'm the one who can't stopsmiling!
Sniffle... I'm so glad that I got to run inthe Takarazuka Kinen!
choice_data_list: Everyone else feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: This was the best Takarazuka Kinen<n>ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: They're all smiling because of you.
They're all smiling because of you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... there's no way. The blue rose<n>brings
happiness, not misfortune, the<n>way I do.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It would take someone really special<n>to make
everyone smile like—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! That means... I... did it...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She bursts into tears, shoulders<n>quivering, while the
audience warmly<n>applauds her.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Brother! I want to run in the<n>Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-Big Sister! I want to run in the<n>Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I want to join too! It'll be the<n>ultimate race!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Like the Takarazuka Kinen, the Arima<n>Kinen is a
race in which only the most<n>popular runners can
participate.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
To think, she's now able to say she<n>wants to
participate without worrying<n>about the requirements.
Which<n>means...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower spends the rest of the<n>day following
me around, pestering<n>me for an answer.
